title: PEAS Formulation — RAMAV
performance_measure: Detection accuracy (true positive rate on known-vulnerable demo PRs)
False approval rate (AUTO_APPROVE granted to a PR that should not have been)
False rejection rate (AUTO_REJECT / HUMAN_REVIEW on a genuinely safe PR)
Decision confidence (the Confidence Engine's output for the final decision)
Evidence completeness (fraction of relevant evidence collected before deciding)
Agent agreement (inverse of the number of unresolved disagreements)
Disagreement detection rate (disagreements correctly identified vs missed)
Time to decision (wall-clock seconds for one full analysis run)
Investigation cost (number of investigation actions executed vs budget)
Percentage of cases safely automated (AUTO_APPROVE + AUTO_REJECT share)
environment: Git repository (local clone; the four demo scenarios are real 2-commit git repos)
GitHub Pull Request (optional; local-clone mode used in this build, see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
Source code under analysis (Python demo repository)
Test suite (unittest/pytest-style tests, executed for real)
CI environment (not wired to a live CI provider in this build; documented as an extension point)
Static-analysis tools (Semgrep when available, deterministic fallback otherwise)
Uncertain / incomplete evidence (tools can be unavailable, tests can be absent)
actuators: Invoke an analysis agent (Security / Testing / Quality / Dependency / Performance)
Request evidence from another agent (REQUEST_EVIDENCE message)
Ask another agent a question (QUESTION / CHALLENGE message)
Reassess a finding (REASSESS message, updates risk/confidence with an audit trail)
Generate a repair patch (Repair Agent, narrow rule-based rewrite only)
Re-run validation against the patched tree
Post a GitHub PR comment (extension point, not wired to a live token in this build)
sensors: Source files (read from the working tree)
AST (Python `ast` module, used by Quality and Performance agents)
Test results (pass/fail/duration from a real unittest/pytest run)
Static-analysis findings (Semgrep JSON or fallback regex matches)
Performance heuristics (loop/DB-call AST patterns; never a fabricated benchmark)
